scope: Maps ProjectGamers/eMuGS vendor update tags (as they appear in project-gamers-oficial video titles) to features/systems. Most rows are TITLE_INFERRED (parsed from the video title only, content not transcribed/verified) -- only rows for videos actually transcribed this sweep are CONTENT_VERIFIED.

versionRangeObserved.note: Parsed from all 108 keyword-relevant video titles in _relevant.tsv; 58 of 108 carry an explicit ADDED/UPDATED X.Y tag, the remaining 50 are untagged general/topic titles.

entries.note: Only entry cross-checked against Blood Moon's real config -- CONFIRMED. Blood Moon's real ItemDrop.txt structurally matches this version or later.
Already fully documented via Research/Vendor/FakeOnline/ pipeline before this sweep.

titleInferredOnly: The remaining ~51 tagged-but-untranscribed titles in _relevant.tsv (versions spanning ADDED/UPDATED 4.2 through 8.9) are known only by title -- e.g. 'Custom Event Zombie - ADDED 8.9', 'Custom Monster HP - ADDED 8.8'. Feature NAME can be read directly off the title, but no config/behavior claim can be made without transcription. See Research/YouTube/project-gamers-oficial/_relevant.tsv for the full list.

bloodMoonProviderVersionStatus.confidence: CONFIRMED for the lower bound (ItemDrop.txt structurally matches 7.0's described change); UNKNOWN for an upper bound -- no evidence yet rules out or confirms Blood Moon running anything from 7.0 up through the latest catalogued 8.9
bloodMoonProviderVersionStatus.reasoning: The ONLY version-anchored real-config cross-check performed this round (CLAIM-004) shows Blood Moon's ItemDrop.txt already has the 7.0 structure. This is one data point, not a full version fingerprint -- Blood Moon could be running exactly 7.0, or any later version, since a config file's structure doesn't change again just because a later update adds unrelated features.
bloodMoonProviderVersionStatus.doNotClaim: An exact version number for Blood Moon's engine build. Only 'at least 7.0' is evidenced.
bloodMoonProviderVersionStatus.nextStep: Cross-check 2-3 more version-anchored claims (e.g. verification-queue.json's queued CLAIM-006/008/010/013 items) against real Blood Moon config once the Part AA safe-inventory tool can locate the exact Data/Custom/*.txt filenames -- each additional match/mismatch narrows the plausible version range.
